_note: Regional resource profiles for The Mortal Age economy (ECONOMY.md §1). Surplus = what the region exports; deficit = what it must import. No region is self-sufficient for masterwork crafting. Read by future quartermasters, merchant pricing, and trade-rumor content — not by v1 code.

wilderness.name: The Wilderness
wilderness.notes: The high tier lives behind PvP. Runite — the metal masterwork smithing needs — only spawns where someone can kill you for it. Risk-gated, not grind-gated.

masterwork_rule: Masterwork-tier crafting requires materials from at least two regions plus one contested or alchemical component (ECONOMY.md §2). This table is the authority for which region supplies what.

asgarnia.name: Asgarnia
asgarnia.notes: The breadbasket. Feeds armies, not forges.

kandarin.name: Kandarin
kandarin.notes: Forested and coastal. The woodshop of the world; no serious mines.

keldagrim.name: Keldagrim
keldagrim.notes: Underground company town. The eight companies dig; they cannot farm. The hungriest buyer in the economy.

misthalin.name: Misthalin
misthalin.notes: Varrock is the commercial hub. Misthalin doesn't produce much — it moves things and takes a cut.

morytania.name: Morytania
morytania.notes: Exports potion ingredients the whole world wants; imports the calories to survive. Net importer.
